_comment: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B, base and distilled, on the style_v1 pictures (five styles x ten pictures) and the sixteen sdxl_v1 prompts, no LoRAs (William's FLUX LoRAs are FLUX.1 and do not apply). Base: 20 steps cfg 5; distilled: 4 steps cfg 1 (negatives ignored). Files: pull_flux.bat. Compare against sdxl_v1 / style_v1 by picture: out/bakeoff/flux2_klein_v1/by_category/<style>/<picture>/. Checkpoints are DISCOVERED by name: any file in flux_models\ or models\diffusion_models\ whose name contains 'klein' (base vs distilled is read from 'base' in the name). The 18 GB klein-9B base William downloaded is cast to fp8 on load and uses qwen_3_8b_fp8mixed (pull_flux.bat 9b); it is NON-COMMERCIAL — bake-off only. 'flux3_image_klein_sd_int8_convrot' is excluded until identified (Q in NEXT_MODELS).
